g.text: M-RPG-HRGV-Net: capacity-normalized uncertainty with monotone role-ambiguity routing

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #647681

g.text: The frozen 17-to-4 mineral-role partition separates raw uncertainty, normalizes its available support, and constrains the role-ambiguity gate contribution.
